name: One of those moments

sourcePrompt: Four-second vertical front-camera iPhone selfie. A young adult man with short dark hair wears a light gray T-shirt and white wired earbuds, seated at home. The phone is close and slightly below eye level, framing his face, shoulders, and forearm near the bottom edge. A large wall clock and dark wooden accent wall are visible behind him. He looks into the lens with a tense, tired expression, then closes his eyes and pinches the bridge of his nose with his thumb and forefinger. He holds it for a beat, releases a quiet sigh, and lowers his hand as the clip ends. His shoulders drop slightly; there is no smile. The movement is quick and familiar, like a brief moment of frustration caught on his phone. One continuous take at normal speed, natural indoor light, slight handheld movement, no speech, captions, lip-sync, or exaggerated acting.
